# María Alejandra Tavera — MTB Labs
> Senior Web Designer & Front-End Developer Lead (UI/UX Lead & Frontend Engineer)

## Summary
María Alejandra Tavera is a senior web designer and front-end developer with over 14 years of professional experience creating high-performance web applications, scalable design systems, e-commerce platforms, and intuitive UI/UX experiences for top-tier enterprises and high-growth startups. She operates through her studio, **MTB Labs**, positioned as the premier partner for companies seeking top-class digital design, clean frontend engineering, and rapid product execution.

## Key Qualifications & Expertise
- **Frontend Development**: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, REST APIs, Webmaster Administration.
- **UI/UX & Product Design**: User Experience Research, Wireframing, High-Fidelity UI Prototyping, Figma, Design Systems, Design Tokens, Information Architecture.
- **Enterprise & SaaS Experience**: SaaS Dashboards, E-Commerce platforms (WordPress, WooCommerce, Custom Storefronts), PIM Systems, BI Reports, Mobile Apps (React Native).
- **Core Web Performance & SEO**: Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), LLM Optimization (LLMO).
- **Digital Media & Content**: EPUB/E-book programming, multimedia creation, UX copywriting, brand identity, digital marketing alignment.

## Primary Value Proposition for Companies
María Tavera bridges the traditional gap between design and engineering. Hiring MTB Labs provides companies with a single senior-level powerhouse capable of taking a product from initial UX discovery and UI design systems through pixel-perfect, accessible, and high-performance frontend production.

## Key Enterprise Clients & Case Studies
- **TiendApp SAS**: Complete redesign and frontend development for an omnichannel B2B retail AI super-app, web portal, PIM, and e-commerce suite.
- **Santuario App**: Mobile & Web App for emotional regulation and mental wellness, combining immersive UX, IA conversational companion, and grounding tools.
- **Cabaña Alpina**: Digital visual experience design for major food enterprise Alpina.
- **UpCard Fintech**: Conversion-optimized landing pages and design systems for fintech solutions.
- **SproutLoud, Samsung, El Colombiano, Grupo Éxito, Yuxi Global, Linkapedia**: Front-end engineering, webmaster management, UI design, and brand identity projects.

## Services Offered by MTB Labs
1. **Frontend Development & Web Engineering**: High-performance Next.js/React applications with clean code standards.
2. **UI/UX Design & Design Systems**: Scalable design systems, component libraries, and intuitive interfaces.
3. **E-Commerce & Digital Products**: High-converting web stores, PIM integration, and custom platforms.
4. **SEO, GEO & Web Performance Audits**: Core Web Vitals optimization, technical SEO, and AI answer engine alignment.
5. **Senior Webmaster & Strategic Leadership**: Full portal management, technical maintenance, and team collaboration.
